components.title: Identify Gold and Silver customers
components.what: From Customers table, list customer_ids with tier Gold (C100, C110) and Silver (C102, C104, C105, C106, C109).

components.title: Filter and dedupe orders
components.what: Remove exact duplicate order rows (same order_id and all fields), then keep only orders with order_date between 2026-04-01 and 2026-06-30 inclusive and status shipped or pending.

components.title: Compute revenue by tier
components.what: For filtered orders, join to customer tier via customer_id, compute units*unit_price per order, sum separately for Gold-tier and Silver-tier customers.

components.title: Compute difference
components.what: Subtract total Silver revenue from total Gold revenue, rounding final result to nearest cent.
